methodologyNotes: Covers self-powered (active) portable PA loudspeakers with a built-in amplifier, sold at a published US MSRP for live sound, DJ, and event reinforcement. Excludes passive (unpowered) cabinets, subwoofers, line-array modules, column PA systems, and studio monitors. Price is typical US MSRP/street in USD. maxSplDb is the manufacturer-rated peak SPL in dB (higher is louder). amplifierPowerW is total rated amplifier power in watts, peak/class-D burst rating as published (not RMS unless only RMS is given). wooferSizeIn is nominal low-frequency driver diameter in inches. frequencyRangeHz is the usable response low-to-high in Hz, at the -10 dB points as published. coverageAngleDeg is nominal horizontal x vertical dispersion in degrees. mixerChannels is the count of onboard input channels/mixer strips (1 for a single line/mic input). hasBluetooth is a boolean: true if it streams audio and/or offers app control over Bluetooth. onboardDsp is a boolean: true if it has user-selectable DSP voicing/contour presets. amplifierClass is an enum (class-d, class-ab, class-d-ab-hybrid). enclosureMaterial is an enum (polypropylene, abs, plywood, composite). weightKg is net cabinet weight in kilograms.
